commands.stdout:
La Roca is the memory your agents leave behind, made searchable.

It reads what Claude, Codex, OpenCode and the rest write to disk, normalizes
that into one local SQLite database, and answers natural-language questions
about it. The database and search index stay on this machine. Natural-language
questions, and up to ten result rows for --full, go to the selected model provider.

Usage:
  roca [flags]
  roca [command]

Available Commands:
  doctor                   Diagnose the configuration and which model is going to answer
  explore                  Investigate one concept through grounded memory
  handoff                  Load session-continuity handoffs
  hooks                    Install and withdraw authorship and session-context hooks
  ingest                   Read every source of the matrix and normalize what changed
  init                     Choose a database and answering model, then bootstrap them
  layers                   Register layers and repair layer drift
  model                    Check or set a provider's answering model
  pill                     Load active pills for the current project
  playground               Human reading room: natural-language SQL and optional prose
  plugin                   Install, update, or uninstall an experimental plugin
  plugins                  List neighbor plugin executables on PATH
  query                    Hybrid FTS and vector search with labeled evidence
  remote                   Run read-only queries across SSH-connected Roca installations
  store                    Write one memory
  uninstall                Remove La Roca, and with your consent its data too
  update                   Replace this binary with the latest published release

Flags:
      --db-path string   database to use
  -h, --help             help for roca
      --json             JSON output
      --read-only        refuse database, audit, and reconciliation writes
  -v, --version          version for roca

Use "roca [command] --help" for more information about a command.
